run_merge_traj_main: run the main function to merge VASP checkpoint trajectories into a single full trajectory file
run_extract_file: run extract_file to unzip a specific file from a VASP checkpoint zip archive
refactor_main_sort_key: refactor the main function to fix the sorted checkpoint key lambda that always uses checkpoint_files[0]
review_extract_file: review the extract_file function to add error handling for missing zip files or extraction failures
summarize_main: summarize the main function that loops through adsorbate directories and merges intermediate checkpoints into full ASE trajectory files
